run_descriptor_unit_tests: run the unittest suite for google.protobuf.internal.descriptor to verify descriptor construction and fixups
test_custom_options_parsing: test that custom options on file, message, field, enum, service, and method descriptors are parsed correctly
test_copytoproto_serialization: test that CopyToProto correctly serializes message, enum, file, and service descriptors to their proto equivalents
test_makedescriptor_factory: test the MakeDescriptor factory function with unsigned int fields to verify cpp_type assignment
test_aggregate_and_nested_options: test that aggregate options and nested options on descriptors are parsed and saved correctly
